name: gopls-lsp
description: Go Language Server for Claude Code

hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in [fF][aA][lL][sS][eE]|0|[nN][oO]|[oO][fF][fF]) ;; *) command -v gopls >/dev/null 2>&1 || { [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-}" ] && [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/bin/gopls" ]; } || ! command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -z "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-}" ] || GOBIN="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/bin" go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest || true ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: When gopls is not on PATH, install it into the plugin data directory with `go install` at session start (requires Go). Turn off to manage gopls yourself.
